method: Fresh mechanics_notes-length census over the live 474-record canonical skill set, excluding every skill with a registered current-evidence audit. The eight shortest remaining records were selected and rechecked against current skill-specific evidence.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported damage values are preserved as source-bound evidence rather than patch-independent constants.
Exact frame data, hidden interactions, unsupported scaling, and reward probabilities are not inferred.
Documented source discrepancies and existing acquisition semantics are retained rather than silently normalized.
